overview.description: The VanEck Avalanche ETF (VAVX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long avax, short usd currency. The fund provides passive exposure to the price of Avalanche (AVAX) and any rewards from staking a portion of its assets. The shares of the Trust allow investors to track the performance of AVAX, without directly purchasing and managing the digital currency. VAVX was launched on Dec 22, 2025 and is issued by VanEck.

data.title: VanEck Introduces Another First with Launch of the VanEck Avalanche ETF (VAVX)
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--VanEck launches VanEck Avalanche ETF (VAVX), first U.S.-listed ETP providing exposure to price return, potential staking rewards of AVAX token.
